title: The module-level flat cotorsion pair on a small ringed site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings. In $\mathcal A=\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], let $\mathcal F$ be the tensor-flat sheaves [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] and put $\mathcal T=\mathcal F^{\perp_1}$. Here $\operatorname{Ext}^1(U,V)=0$ means that every short exact sequence $0\to V\to E\to U\to0$ splits, and right and left $\perp_1$ denote vanishing against every object of the indicated class.
Then $\mathcal F={}^{\perp_1}\mathcal T$. The pair $(\mathcal F,\mathcal T)$ is hereditary: $\operatorname{Ext}^i(F,T)=0$ for every $i\geq1$, $F\in\mathcal F$, $T\in\mathcal T$, with higher Ext interpreted as Yoneda extensions; in particular $\mathcal F$ is closed under kernels of epimorphisms between its objects and $\mathcal T$ under cokernels of monomorphisms between its objects. Both classes are closed under extensions and retracts, and $\mathcal F$ is closed under small coproducts. There is a set $S\subseteq\mathcal F$ such that $\mathcal T=S^{\perp_1}$. There is a flat generator $G\in\mathcal F$, meaning that every object of $\mathcal A$ is an epimorphic image of a small coproduct of copies of $G$. No points or projective objects of the site are assumed.
